summary.text: Larry Labor, a Republican from Morgan, has represented Essex-Orleans in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2022.
He is vice chair of the House Committee on Environment.

paragraphs.text: Labor was born in Newport, Vermont, in July 1944, graduated from Sacred Heart High School in 1962, and graduated from the Massachusetts College of Pharmacy in 1967, according to his House biography.
He worked for the Eastside Pharmacy and then, from 1971, at North Country Hospital, where he was director of pharmacy for 43 years.
His career at the hospital also included service as vice president of professional services and interim positions as CEO.
He served seven years on the Vermont Board of Pharmacy, including one year as chair, and was elected to the Morgan Select Board in 2009.
He and his wife, Pauline, have four children and five grandchildren.
